_about: Baselines, in 1/300-inch device px from the page top, of every line of every probe in tools/make_line_box_probe.py as Word 16.106 exported them, one list per page; and the hhea/typo integers (upm, ascent, descent, lineGap) of each face. Measurements only; regenerate with tools/read_line_box_probe.py --record.
